contentText:
Stephanie Palazzolo / The Information :

Sources: Sam Altman told staff that OpenAI is expected to go public “within the next year” and OpenAI plans a tender offer “very soon” at a $687.69 share price   —  OpenAI CEO Sam Altman told staff in a Slack message on Monday that he expects OpenAI to go public …
